operational_reality: WebSearch reaches ALL target sources with dated snippet-level facts. WebFetch is EGRESS-BLOCKED for the primary stats domains (FanGraphs, Baseball Savant, Baseball-Reference, Rotowire, Massey, official WNBA/MLB injury PDFs). Row-level table scraping is NOT available without allowlisting or a paid API. Plan around WebSearch narrative + snippets; confirm against official day-of reports.
sources: READ TIMESTAMP: source-scouting run as of ~2026-08-08 afternoon ET. No game specifics pulled, per instructions (games array intentionally empty).

OPERATIONAL FINDING (critical for the model going forward): WebSearch reaches and usefully surfaces ALL target sources, often returning dated, snippet-level data in the result summary (e.g., 'FanGraphs RosterResource injury report updated Sat Aug 8 2026 7:46 AM ET'; 'Rotowire lineup card Aug 4 2026'; 585 players on MLB ILs). But WebFetch / direct page fetch is EGRESS-BLOCKED for essentially every primary sports-stats domain. Directly tested and got error_type EGRESS_BLOCKED on: www.fangraphs.com, baseballsavant.mlb.com, www.rotowire.com, www.baseball-reference.com, masseyratings.com. Proxy status also logged a 403 CONNECT to ak-static.cms.nba.com (NBA/WNBA CMS). CONCLUSION: rely on WebSearch for narrative + snippet-level facts; row-level table scraping via WebFetch is NOT available for these domains without allowlisting or a paid API/ingestion path.

MLB advanced metrics -- FanGraphs (fangraphs.com/leaders/major-league, /leaders/war, /depthcharts.aspx?position=Team, /roster-resource/injury-report, /roster-resource/closer-depth-chart): provides wRC+, wOBA, WAR, FIP/xFIP, team WAR depth charts + projections, RosterResource injury & closer feeds. Reachability: WebSearch surfaces 2026 leaderboard URLs and RosterResource timestamps well; WebFetch BLOCKED (EGRESS_BLOCKED tested). Caveat: high-quality, but only search-snippet access -- cannot pull full tables directly.

MLB advanced metrics -- Baseball Savant / Statcast (baseballsavant.mlb.com/leaderboard/expected_statistics, /leaderboard/custom?year=2026, /leaderboard/percentile-rankings, /statcast_leaderboard, /leaderboard/swing-take): xBA/xwOBA/xSLG expected stats, exit velo & barrels, run values, percentile rankings, park factors, custom year-filtered leaderboards. Reachability: WebSearch surfaces all leaderboard URLs; WebFetch BLOCKED (EGRESS_BLOCKED tested). Caveat: authoritative Statcast source but not fetchable for structured rows here.

MLB advanced metrics -- Baseball-Reference (baseball-reference.com/leagues/majors/2026-advanced-batting.shtml, 2026-advanced-pitching.shtml, /2026.shtml, /leagues/MLB-standings.shtml): standard + advanced team/player batting & pitching, standings, splits. Reachability: WebSearch surfaces 2026 pages cleanly; WebFetch BLOCKED (EGRESS_BLOCKED tested). Caveat: canonical season/historical stats, search-snippet access only.

MLB injury/lineup -- Rotowire (rotowire.com/baseball/injury-report.php, /lineup-card.php, /news.php): per-team injury report with severity score, daily lineup cards (with weather/injuries/matchups), fantasy news. Reachability: WebSearch surfaces well with dated snippets (lineup card, injury counts); WebFetch BLOCKED (EGRESS_BLOCKED tested). Caveat: strong aggregator, but lineups are often 'expected' vs confirmed -- cross-check official before locking a line.

MLB injury/lineup -- MLB.com official (mlb.com/injury-report, mlb.com/news/baseball-injury-updates): official injury report and transactions; official lineups/news posted day-of. Reachability: WebSearch surfaces with real snippets (e.g., IL moves, rehab starts); WebFetch UNTESTED but almost certainly BLOCKED (sibling domain baseballsavant.mlb.com blocked, NBA CMS 403). Caveat: authoritative for transactions/official confirmations.

MLB secondary injury cross-checks -- ESPN (espn.com/mlb/injuries), CBS Sports (cbssports.com/mlb/injuries), Covers (covers.com/sport/baseball/mlb/injuries): aggregated injury/status feeds and team pages; good for corroboration. Reachability: WebSearch surfaces all; WebFetch not separately tested (assume blocked for espn.com per NBA/ESPN infra pattern).

MLB bullpen usage -- Rotowire (rotowire.com/baseball/closers.php, /reliever-usage.php, /bullpen-usage.php[?team=XXX]): closer roles/hierarchy, relievers pitched 2+ days in a row (rest candidates), per-team bullpen usage. Reachability: WebSearch surfaces per-team URLs; WebFetch BLOCKED (rotowire egress-blocked). Caveat: best readily-searchable bullpen-fatigue signal.

MLB bullpen usage -- InsidethePen (insidethepen.com/bullpen-usage.html, /closers-by-team.html): daily all-30-team usage tracker (who pitched yesterday, 3-days-in-a-row, who's fresh), power rankings. Reachability: WebSearch surfaces; WebFetch UNTESTED (smaller domain -- may be fetchable, worth a probe). Also ESPN reliever depth chart and FanGraphs RosterResource closer depth chart as cross-checks.

MLB park/weather -- Rotowire (rotowire.com/baseball/weather.php + park-factors article): game-time temp, wind direction/speed relative to park dimensions, HR-impact, per-park factors. Reachability: WebSearch surfaces with dated weather report (Aug 7 2026); WebFetch BLOCKED. Secondary: Baseball Savant park factors, Covers/Cleatz/PropFinder MLB weather (surfaced via WebSearch). Use only when weather is extreme/material to totals.

WNBA power ratings -- Massey Ratings (masseyratings.com/wnba, /wnba/ratings, /wnba/games): neutral computer power ratings, predictions, schedule. Reachability: WebSearch surfaces; WebFetch BLOCKED (EGRESS_BLOCKED tested). Complementary neutral ratings surfaced via WebSearch: ESPN WNBA BPI/projections (espn.com/wnba/bpi), Neil Paine Elo (neilpaine.substack.com -- Substack may be fetchable), dratings.com Donchess Index.

WNBA advanced stats -- Basketball-Reference (basketball-reference.com/wnba/years/2026_advanced.html, /wnba/years/2026.html): advanced player/team stats, season summary, ratings. Reachability: WebSearch surfaces 2026 pages; WebFetch UNTESTED but LIKELY BLOCKED (same Sports Reference operator as baseball-reference, which is confirmed blocked). Caveat: canonical but search-snippet access only.

WNBA advanced stats -- WNBA.com / stats.wnba.com (wnba.com/stats/team-stats-advanced, stats.wnba.com/teams/advanced/): official advanced team/player stats -- pace, off/def/net rating. Reachability: WebSearch surfaces; WebFetch LIKELY BLOCKED (NBA/WNBA CMS ak-static.cms.nba.com returned 403 CONNECT in proxy log). Caveat: authoritative official advanced analytics.

WNBA advanced stats -- HerHoopStats (herhoopstats.com/stats/wnba/league/2026/): specialist women's-basketball advanced stats, season summary, team comparisons, game logs. Reachability: WebSearch surfaces; WebFetch UNTESTED (worth probing; some content is subscription-gated). Caveat: high-quality specialist source, possible paywall on deeper tables.

WNBA injury/rest -- WNBA.com official injury report (wnba.com/wnba-injury-report): teams must designate participation status + specific injury by 5 p.m. local the day before a game (reliable timing anchor). Reachability: WebSearch surfaces; WebFetch LIKELY BLOCKED (NBA/WNBA CMS 403). Secondary injury/rest cross-checks surfaced via WebSearch: Rotowire WNBA (rotowire.com/wnba/injury-report.php, /wnba/news.php?view=injuries), CBS Sports, Covers, NBC Rotoworld, ESPN team injury pages. Caveat: some WebSearch injury snippets can be stale -- always confirm against the official 5pm-prior report for the specific game date. Also track rest / back-to-back schedule via Massey/WNBA.com schedule.
